head.h1: Proposal Dinner Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: Proposal dinner catering in Dubai from myCHEF is a private, chef-cooked dinner styled around your proposal, from AED 1,200 for two. A vetted chef designs the menu, cooks it in your own space, serves each course and clears everything away, so the only thing you carry is the ring. Tell us the date, the venue and the number of guests, and you will have an itemised proposal promptly during our published business hours.

new_paragraphs: How much does proposal dinner catering cost in Dubai?

Proposal dinner catering in Dubai starts from AED 1,200 for a plated dinner for two. The final figure depends on the menu, the number of courses and the service level, so send your details for an itemised quote.
What is included in proposal dinner catering?
Included is a bespoke menu, a private chef, full table service, setup and discreet styling, plus cleanup afterwards. You focus on the moment; the chef handles the kitchen from start to finish.
Can you cook the proposal dinner at my home or villa?
Yes — proposal dinner home catering in Dubai is our most requested format. The chef cooks on-site at your apartment, villa, rooftop or a private venue, and leaves the space exactly as it was found.
Do you offer halal and vegetarian proposal dinner menus?
Yes. Every proposal dinner menu can be prepared fully halal, and we cater vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and other dietary needs. Share the preferences and any allergies when you enquire.
How do I hire a proposal dinner caterer in Dubai?
Hiring is clear: send your date, guest count and venue, and we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal. We confirm the menu and timings with you before the day.
How far in advance should I book?

As guidance: 48 hours for a standard private-chef dinner, 5–7 days for a bespoke menu with styling, and 7–14 days or more if a larger engagement celebration is attached. Lead times depend on guest numbers, menu complexity, staffing, equipment, location and partner availability. Tight timeline for your proposal dinner? We check live partner availability before saying yes or no.
Which areas of Dubai do you cover?
All of Dubai — including Palm Jumeirah, Downtown, Dubai Marina, Emirates Hills, Jumeirah and Business Bay, as well as private venues, rooftops and yachts across the city.
For proposal dinner catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: What is on a proposal dinner menu in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Every proposal dinner menu in Dubai is built for you, not chosen from a set list. A classic evening runs three to five courses — a canapé or amuse to open, a starter, a main and a dessert designed to double as the moment — but the shape is yours. Couples often ask for the dish from a first date, a cuisine from a shared trip, or a menu that leans Mediterranean, French, Arabic or Asian. All proposal dinner food catering can be prepared fully halal, and we handle vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, gluten-free and allergy-specific requests without treating them as an afterthought. Wine or non-alcoholic pairings can be suggested to match each course. Dessert is where many proposals land, so it is worth planning: a plated finale, a ring-reveal dish, or a small celebration cake for afterward. Share likes, dislikes and any dietary needs at enquiry and the chef returns a draft menu to refine together.

add_block.new_heading: The opening bites, and choosing the cuisine
new_paragraphs: Most proposal evenings open with something you can eat standing up, holding a glass, while the chef finishes plating out of sight. Two warm bites and one cold one is usually right. It is the same craft as finger food catering in Dubai scaled down to two people: canapés built to be picked up cleanly, nothing that needs cutlery, nothing that needs explaining halfway through. It matters more than it sounds, because a proposal that starts with fifteen silent minutes at an empty table starts on the back foot. If the night grows into an engagement gathering for family the following week, that same canapé service scales up to a standing table without turning into a buffet. On cuisine, couples most often ask for the dish from a first date or the food from a shared trip. Lebanese is the most requested of those in Dubai by a distance — a mezze opening, then a grill, which suits an unhurried evening better than a formal tasting sequence — and our Arabic and Lebanese catering page covers those menus in full. French, Italian, Japanese and modern Emirati evenings are built the same way, by a chef who cooks that cuisine for a living rather than one adapting a house menu to fit.

add_block.new_heading: Is there a cheap way to do a proposal dinner in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Not in the way the word usually means, and it is fairer to say so than to imply otherwise. People searching for cheap proposal dinner catering in Dubai are almost always after a real number rather than a bargain, so here it is: AED 1,200 buys a plated dinner for two, cooked and served in your own space. That is the floor for a chef-led evening, not a stripped-back version of one. What moves the figure is course count, ingredient level and styling — there is no budget tier and premium tier, just a menu that grows. If the budget is the binding constraint, there are two honest routes. Cut courses instead of quality: three courses cooked properly beat five stretched thin, and the chef will tell you which to drop. Or, when the evening is really an engagement gathering for a group rather than a dinner for two, change format entirely — a spread dropped off ready to serve starts at AED 90 per person, a buffet at AED 120 and a live station at AED 150, against AED 700 to 950 per person for a chef cooking and serving on site. Volume formats carry a 10-guest minimum, 20 for a full buffet, and a minimum order value of AED 900. What we will not do is quote a low per-head figure and recover it in extras on the final invoice.

If your own space is not right, we can point you toward private venues through our partners. Styling is kept intentional and discreet: a laid table, soft lighting, and only the details that carry meaning, not a cluttered scene. The aim is an evening that looks effortless because the work stayed invisible.
